issues.reason: The flat (Member sk_store_1 large) and the reified sk_large_1 state assert at 1.0/0.99 an antecedent the sentence only conditions on — 'Assert only what the text states' — and the two-plain-events route they imitate is licensed only for definite participants 'in a one-off narrative', not for a present-tense regularity, which the 'when' paragraph says must not be left unquantified.

The status-less tend bundle is a standing habitual ('the Keepers tend the lanterns safely') whose only restriction, the During link, anchors on a state the parse itself asserts unconditionally, so the 'when' qualifier is effectively dropped — 'a stated restriction, hedge or qualifier is never silently dropped: omitting it widens the claim'.

The per-member rule asserts every Keeper's safe tending at strength 1.0 with no condition at all — not even the During anchor the group event carries — widening the claim beyond the text (Core patterns) and leaving the regularity unquantified for each member.

gaps_confirmed: a present-tense habitual 'when P, Q' over all-definite participants: the routing paragraph keys on indefinite participants (whenever rule) versus definites in a one-off narrative (two events) and leaves this case unrouted by its letter, although the 'Every time the bell rings' example (definites typed at top level, variable over occurrences) and the indicative-conditional Implication rule supply the form
no test for when a capitalized plural kind-word label ('the Keepers') refers as a name (Name-only individual) versus a definite plural (GroupOf)
new_gaps: a copular-state trigger ('when X is P, ...') for a whenever rule: the premise must be a reified state pattern with a plain variable, yet a later flat (Member sk_store_1 large) would never match it — no premise form or dual-emit requirement is stated for copular triggers
a distributive predicate over a definite group inside a whenever-rule consequent: no stated home for the per-member (PartOf $x <group>) rule inside another rule's conclusion
defect_summary: Issue 0: the antecedent belongs only in a rule premise — sk_watch_1, sk_store_1 and their Possession stay at top level as presupposed definites, the large-state becomes the premise pattern (And (Member $s large) (Experiencer $s sk_store_1)), and no flat or reified large-state is asserted. Issue 1: the consequent belongs in that rule's conclusion as the per-occurrence Skolem event (sk_tend $s) with Agent sk_keepers_1, Theme sk_lanterns_1, Manner safely and (During (sk_tend $s) $s), at (STV 1.0 0.9), with no standing tend bundle. Issue 2: the per-member distribution must carry the same conditioning, but the instruction set states no form for a (PartOf $x <group>) rule nested inside another rule's conclusion, so no fully compliant per-member form is licensed (filed as a gap).
